summary.content:
Today's selection covers 111 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 71 on Artificial Intelligence and 14 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Canva’s first AI image model plans designs before generating them
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Authorities disrupt nearly 11,000 cybercrime networks in Africa
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, NY Times Tech, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 57 articles published in the last 24 hours
